original_questionnaire: PURE South Africa Adult Questionnaire, 28 April 2005
response_options: #1 and #2 numeric measurements, cm; minimal/no clothing; full clothing. Facing PDF page 34: refusal recorded as 0 in each box; refers to instruction manual for detailed procedures.
calculation_or_encoding: PINTIG adaptation: arithmetic mean of two valid measurements in cm, rounded to 0.1 cm. Both required. Refusal/missing/invalid => missing, never a numeric circumference. Clothing stored separately; no clothing correction invented.
expected_range: Positive physical measurement; simulation restricted to 65-160 cm (PINTIG assumption, not questionnaire limits)
source_data_availability: simulated measurements; final arithmetic derivation remains simulated in provenance
model_compatibility: Same continuous cm feature; old generator used a single artificial waist-conditioned value. New measurement-pair mean changes the simulation definition and requires new experiments.
limitations: PURE measurement instruction manual not supplied; anatomical tape placement and official replicate-combination rule unverified. Mean is a proposed PINTIG adaptation. No actual hip measurements in framingham.csv. Offspring10/Omni5 PDF p73 T01 hip supports another protocol in inches to next lower quarter inch, not substituted here.

original_question_number: Unnumbered diabetes medication item, MD02; no numeric question identifier printed
original_question_wording: Have you ever taken medication for high blood sugar or diabetes?
response_options: 0=no, 1=yes,now, 2=yes,not now, 9=unk. If yes: age began medicine (99=unk); Was insulin your first diabetes medication? (0=no, 1=yes, 9=unk); Did diabetes occur in pregnancy only (0=no, 1=yes, 9=unk).
calculation_or_encoding: Current treatment = 1 for response 1; 0 for responses 0 or 2; missing for 9 or missing/invalid response. Follow-up items are not necessary to encode current use and are not generated; no fabricated medication-start history.
source_data_availability: simulated original categorical response, then encoded; no observed diabetes drug field
model_compatibility: Matches established binary current-diabetes-treatment interpretation. Actual DIABETES is preserved and is not itself a drug-use measurement.
limitations: Available local filename lacks requested '(1)'; exact local file hash recorded, byte identity with missing alternate filename not asserted. Gen3 form does not describe the historical source cohort. No-treatment assignment for baseline DIABETES=0 is a simulation restriction, not a universal clinical rule. PURE PDF p9 Q18 uses at-least-weekly use in last month: different recall definition, not substituted.

original_questionnaire: PURE South Africa Adult Questionnaire, 28 April 2005
section: 35. Please answer the following: (Choose only one option for each)
original_question_wording: How often have you felt stress at work in the last 12 months? | How often have you felt stress at home in the last 12 months?
response_options: No response; Never Experienced Stress; Some Period of Stress; Several Periods of Stress; Permanent Stress. Work item: Mark here if not applicable: i.e. no longer working. Stress definition: feeling irritable or filled with anxiety, or as having sleeping difficulties as a result of conditions at work or at home.
calculation_or_encoding: PINTIG-only binary adaptation: 1 if either applicable item is Several Periods of Stress or Permanent Stress; 0 if all applicable items are Never Experienced Stress or Some Period of Stress; otherwise missing. Work not applicable is skipped, not coded as no stress. Home always applicable. Preserve original response strings in sidecar; no questionnaire numeric codes invented.
measurement_unit: Original ordinal categories over 12 months; final binary
expected_range: Original named categories plus work not applicable; final 0/1 or missing
source_data_availability: simulated item responses, then derived binary; no observed stress responses
model_compatibility: Numeric binary type matches; construct is more explicit than legacy arbitrary Bernoulli stress. Not interchangeable with an established validated scale or legacy fitted model.
limitations: Questionnaire provides no validated binary score. Threshold and aggregation are proposed adaptations, not PURE scoring instructions. Financial stress Q36 and depression Q37 are separate constructs and are excluded. Verified South African form, not Philippine form.

section: Physical Activity Questionnaire--Framingham Heart Study, Tech-administered; Rest and Activity for a Typical Day; form 70205, TECH05
original_question_number: Unnumbered Sleep row, TECH05; no numeric question identifier printed
original_question_wording: Sleep--Number of hours that you typically sleep?
response_options: Numeric hours, blank line. Activities must equal 24 hours. Other rows: Sedentary, Slight Activity, Moderate Activity, Heavy Activity.
calculation_or_encoding: Direct numeric reported typical-day sleep hours; no bedtime subtraction or IPAQ MET conversion. Simulate direct response first and copy to feature. Supporting non-overlapping activity hours sum with sleep to 24. Blank/invalid => missing.
expected_range: Logical 0-24 hours; simulation restricted to 3.5-10.5 hours (legacy PINTIG assumption, not questionnaire validity cutoffs)
model_compatibility: Same continuous hours name and legacy simulated bounds; typical-day interpretation documented. No actual sleep responses in source.
limitations: Gen3 form belongs to another cohort. Available filename lacks '(1)'. Offspring10/Omni5 p79 T04 pai_sleep additionally specifies past year and 99 unknown; these are not silently imposed on Gen3. PURE p19 Q29 bedtime/wake/naps measures time in bed rather than verified sleep. IPAQ scoring sleep assumption is not a measured response.
